langName: European Spanish (Spain: vosotros, vale, coger, ordenador, móvil, piso, vale — never Latin American forms)
title: Spanisch B1 · Teil 1
focus: Narrating the past: pretérito indefinido vs. imperfecto in contrast (background vs. event), pretérito perfecto for today/recent/life experience, 'estaba + gerundio cuando + indefinido', 'iba a + infinitivo' for abandoned plans. About 60% of sentences must carry one of these.
always: Presente (incl. irregular and stem-changing verbs), reflexive verbs, 'ir a + infinitivo' for near future, direct/indirect object pronouns, gustar/encantar/parecer family, basic connectors (porque, pero, así que, entonces, además).
avoidGrammar: No subjuntivo, no condicional, no futuro simple, no pluscuamperfecto — those belong to later parts.
register: Spoken everyday Spanish between friends, family, colleagues, neighbours, shop staff. Fillers welcome: bueno, pues, es que, o sea, vale, la verdad, ¿sabes?, venga.
